name: Better Nuvio
subtitle: Nuvio Mobile fork with subtitle AutoSync
description: Better Nuvio for iPhone and iPad: a fork of Nuvio Mobile with subtitle AutoSync (aligns addon subtitles to the video using the embedded subtitles of MKV files) and other improvements from Better Nuvio for TV.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Better Nuvio logo on the login, loading and settings screens
- Better Nuvio app icon

- Based on Nuvio Mobile 0.5.9-beta
